surface_mechanism_description: The nitrogen atoms incorporated into the interfacial region of the HfO2 film during the PEALD process using N2O plasma effectively suppressed the growth of the interfacial Hf silicate layer. The ions in the plasma physically attacked the film, and radicals chemically reacted with ligands of the Hf(NC2H5)4 precursor during the PEALD process.
